== Photo sources: any source, Small World Rule (Bill, 2026-10-27) ==

Bill 27 October 2026: a photo of a person may come from any source; the only test is how certain it is that the photo shows the same person. Small World Rule for photos: a distinctive name plus a Decipher or SWCCG link (for example, a Decipher staffer of that name) means the photo is taken as the same person, with the reasoning recorded on the person page's Talk page. This replaces the older source limits in [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Photos of people]]: photos only from SWCCG websites or events (2026-10-12), the public SWCCG Facebook allowance, and requiring the same source to name the person's Decipher work. Kept: no obscene gestures, cite the source with a Preserved copy, credit the photographer when known, and every new photo goes in the Photographs gallery. Also updated: the Photo identification bullet of the small-world standing rule, the Hunt a lead photograph and Add good extras bullets (dropped "SWCCG-associated"), and the Pictures for articles bullet formerly titled Photo sources still apply (now limited to event, place and website pictures).
[[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 20:14, 27 October 2026 (UTC)
